hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\"}}"'
hooks.description: Enforce declared model tier for SDLC pipeline agents. Reads model: from agent frontmatter and injects the correct model ID via updatedInput before the Agent tool fires. Fails open for unknown agents. Resolution: ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (always set for plugin hooks), else the dev-checkout path, else allow.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch-log.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch-log.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/dispatch-log.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Dispatch telemetry (pending row): records agent_type + description of every Agent dispatch made while a pipeline run state file is fresh, so usage-report.sh can attribute measured usage to phases. Silent, no-op outside a run.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/pre-commit-guard.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Guard git commit during a pipeline run: deny --no-verify, deny staged secrets (file:line in the reason), warn on debug leftovers outside test paths. No-op outside a run, so a human commit is never second-guessed.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch-log.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch-log.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/dispatch-log.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Dispatch telemetry (start row): pairs the assigned agent_id with the pending dispatch of the same agent_type. Silent, no-op outside a run.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/subagent-usage.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/subagent-usage.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/subagent-usage.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Dispatch telemetry (stop row): sums the finished subagent's transcript usage (deduped by message.id), prices it from references/pricing.json and appends the measured row. Synchronous on purpose — the orchestrator reads the log right after the Agent call returns. Silent, no-op outside a run.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start-stack-cache.sh" ]; then exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start-stack-cache.sh"; fi; f="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/session-start-stack-cache.sh"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec bash "$f"; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Precompute and cache stack-profile detection (pipeline-orchestrator Step 0b) at session start so /sdlc:start and /sdlc:doctor can skip the Glob+Read+parse pass. Writes to ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/stack-cache/. Silent, side-effect-only, fails open. No matcher: the script itself filters out 'compact'/'fork' sources.
